subject: general
question: Mango showers can be defined as:

options.text: pre-monsoon showers which are common in the states of Karnataka and Kerala
monsoon showers which are common in the states of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar
Snow storms during the winter season
post-monsoon showers which are common in the states of Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is__** pre-monsoon showers which are common in the states of Karnataka and Kerala**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mango showers are pre-monsoon shower**s that are **common in the states of Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• They are** also known as summer rains**. 
 
• Mango showers a**re pre-monsoon showers that occur at the end of summer. **
 
• They a**re common in the coastal areas of Karnataka and Kerala. **
 
• **They are usually difficult to predict by the meteorological department. **
 
• They can range from light drizzles to violent thunderstorms. 
 
• They help in the early ripening of mangoes. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Blossom showers -

 
 
• This is also known as a cherry blossom or espresso shower.
 
• This occurs nearby the wind areas.
 
• This period in India is referred to as the early monsoon.
 
 
 
• Tea shower -
 
 
• Pre-monsoon rain is required for tea plantations.
 
• This is known as the 'Tea shower' in Assam.
 
• In West Bengal, it is called Kalbaishakh.
